select pm.user_id, su.user_name, su.nick_name, su.email, sd.dept_name, (select sr.role_name from sys_user_role sur left join sys_role sr on sr.role_id = sur.role_id where sur.user_id = su.user_id order by sur.role_id limit 1) as role_name, pm.creator, pm.joined_time from pmhub_project_member pm inner join sys_user su on pm.user_id = su.user_id left join sys_dept sd on su.dept_id = sd.dept_id where pm.pt_id = #{req.projectId} and pm.type = 'project'
and (su.nick_name like concat('%', #{req.keyword}, '%') or su.email like concat('%', #{req.keyword}, '%'))
order by pm.joined_time asc
